about_the_game:
🌒 A cursed village. A land devoured by demons.

Restore the ancestral farm, make a pact or resist… and decide the fate of Valmirae.

Valmirae’s Pact is a pixel-art farming and life simulation game — playable solo or with friends — blending farming, village life, and exploration of a wild world that regenerates every week. Grow your crops, learn village crafts, improve your home… but never forget that each season, the demons demand their due.

🧑‍🌾 Grow. Build. Thrive.

  • Plant, water, harvest and process your grains, vegetables, flowers and magical essences

  • Expand your farm and customize your home with new rooms and workshops unlocked through your skills progression

  • Unlock new talents and crafting recipes tied to your activities

  • Fish, forge, cook, brew and distill powerful potions

🏘️ Meet the people you fight for

  • Build unique relationships with villagers hiding deep secrets

  • Trade with local artisans and help them expand their shops

  • Potentially marry the partner of your choice

  • Help the community push back corruption… or let it consume them

🌲 Venture into the Wildlands

  • Explore procedurally-generated regions with increasingly hostile biomes

  • Fight off corrupted creatures

  • Gather rare resources and unique plants for your potions

🔥 The Pact… or Ruin

  • Each season change brings blessings or disasters

  • Demonic curses alter gameplay in unpredictable ways

  • Your choices determine the village’s fate and your bond with the demons

🛠️ The game is currently in active development. We frequently share updates — join the community and help shape the future of Valmirae!

💜 Wishlist now to support the development and stay updated on major announcements!

  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: Intégrée compatible DirectX

short_description: Farm, explore and survive in a world torn between the light of seasons and the shadow of pacts. Valmirae’s Pact blends peaceful life-sim farming with dark demonic mystery.
